_schema.note: Canonical catalog for the mountain biking quiz (mountainbiking.html). Edit this file directly and push — GitHub Pages redeploys automatically. Optional live override: set SHEET_CSV_URL in mountainbiking.html to a published Google Sheet CSV with the same column names. First pass, added 2026-09-20: 8 real bikes sourced live from konaworld.com and an authorized Specialized retailer (cyclingelements.ca) — a solid spread across hardtail XC and full-suspension trail/enduro, but thin on downhill/dirt-jump and only two brands so far. Grow this the same way the other catalogs grew: send specific pages, or ask for another research pass. See DATA.md for full scope notes.

fields.name: string — model name shown to users
fields.origin: string — country of the brand, used for the 'prefer Canadian' filter
fields.wheel: number — 26, 27.5, or 29 (inches); use 27.5 for a mixed/mullet setup (larger rear, smaller front) since none in this catalog are mullet yet
fields.sizes: array of 'XS'|'S'|'M'|'L'|'XL' — MTB brands size by letter, not cm, unlike the road/gravel catalogs. Scoring uses minH/maxH for fit, not this list directly (yet).
fields.minH: number — cm, lower bound of rider height this bike fits across all its sizes
fields.maxH: number — cm, upper bound of rider height this bike fits across all its sizes
fields.price: number — face-value price in whatever 'currency' says
fields.currency: optional string, 3-letter code — omit to mean USD
fields.availability: 'mainstream' | 'boutique' — mainstream: normal dealer network. boutique: smaller/premium, limited distribution.
fields.frameStyle: 'step-through' | 'step-over' | 'either' — every entry here is 'step-over': real mountain bikes need diamond-frame rigidity for off-road loads, and aren't sold step-through — a categorical fact about the bike type, same reasoning as the racing/bikepacking catalogs.
fields.discipline: 'xc' | 'trail' | 'enduro' | 'downhill' | 'dirt_jump' — the terrain/riding style this bike is actually built for, scored with adjacency (an XC bike scores worse but not zero for someone who said 'trail', etc.) rather than a hard filter.
fields.travelFront: number — front fork travel in mm
fields.travelRear: number — rear shock travel in mm, 0 for a hardtail
fields.groupset: string — drivetrain as sold (e.g. 'Shimano Deore 11-speed', 'SRAM Eagle 70 Transmission')
fields.image: string — relative path or full URL to a product photo; leave empty to show the sketch placeholder
fields.retailerUrl: optional string — a specific product page URL, set ONLY when a human (or this AI, having actually fetched that exact page) has confirmed it shows this bike. When absent, the result card links to a live web search instead.

bikes.name: Fire Mountain
bikes._verified: Full specs (frame, fork, drivetrain, brakes, price) confirmed live at en-ca.konaworld.com on 2026-09-20. Wheel size varies by frame size (26in XS, 27.5in S, 29in M-XL) — catalogued here as 29 since M-XL is the range most adult riders fall into; height range spans all sizes. Weight not published on the product page.

bikes.name: Lava Dome
bikes._verified: Full specs confirmed live at en-ca.konaworld.com on 2026-09-20. Same per-size wheel variation as Fire Mountain. Weight not published.

bikes.name: Rockhopper
bikes._verified: Specs confirmed via an authorized Specialized retailer (cyclingelements.ca) on 2026-09-20 — specialized.com itself blocks automated fetches (403). Fork travel (100mm) and height range are estimates typical for this class, not shown on the retailer page; worth a follow-up if precision matters. Listed as sold out at this retailer at the time of the pass, which doesn't affect its fit as a catalog entry.

bikes.name: Chisel Comp Evo
bikes._verified: IMPORTANT: Specialized's 'Chisel' line has historically been a hardtail in general product knowledge, but this specific listing (cyclingelements.ca, 2026-09-20) explicitly specs a 130mm Fox 34 fork AND 110mm of rear travel with a flex-stay design, described as 'the lightest, fastest alloy full-suspension bike in the world' — catalogued as full_suspension per the sourced page rather than assumed hardtail. Worth double-checking against a second source if this matters for a specific recommendation. Height range is an estimate for this class of race-XC frame, not shown on the retailer page. Listed as sold out at this retailer at the time of the pass.

bikes.name: Mahuna
bikes._verified: Found while pulling catalog updates via cyclingelements.ca on 2026-09-20. Wheel size, sizes, 100mm fork travel, 11-speed drivetrain, hydraulic disc brakes, and sale price confirmed live. Exact groupset brand/model and frame material weren't stated on the retailer page — frameMaterial:aluminum and the generic '11-speed' groupset label are typical-for-class, not directly confirmed; worth a follow-up on konaworld.com if precision matters.
